title: multi-sdk credential telemetry, graceful stream handles, and parity fixes
author: Nadia Park
description: Context: customers running long-lived streaming sessions asked for clearer signal around credential refresh events and leak-free stream handles (see ENG-2481). This PR introduces lightweight credential telemetry, improves streaming handle lifecycle semantics across Python/TS/Go SDKs, and synchronizes small parity fixes and version bumps. Goals: 1) Emit compact telemetry metrics when a credential refresh is triggered (reason + latency + succeeded/failed). 2) Make stream handles cancel/idempotent close safe across SDKs and expose a new Stream.close_graceful() helper for deterministic shutdown. 3) Small parity fixes: align error codes for AuthFailure between SDKs, normalize default backoff windows, and bump packaged SDK versions. Changes included (high level): - Python SDK: add cred_telemetry event emission, add Stream.close_graceful() implementation that drains in-progress buffers and cancels on timeout, tests for idempotency, bump py SDK to 0.38.2. - TypeScript SDK: expose onCredentialRefresh telemetry hook, add optional gracefulClose(timeoutMs) on StreamingClient, normalize AuthFailure.code to "AUTH_EXPIRED", bump ts SDK to 1.6.0. - Go SDK: emit minimal cred metrics via telemetry client interface, make StreamHandle.Close() idempotent and add CloseGraceful(ctx, timeout), adjust retry preset names for parity, bump go SDK to v1.5.1. Checklist: - [x] Design review (ENG-2481) - [x] Implement Python changes, unit+integration tests - [x] Implement TypeScript changes, unit tests and e2e smoke - [x] Implement Go changes and unit tests - [x] Cross-SDK parity review and docs update - [x] CI green and squash-merge Note: this description is a single continuous string; detailed file level diffs and test outputs are summarized below. Related: docs PR will follow that adds small console docs and a telemetry event spec.
